name: Dan McAran
abstract_title: Cantor, Gödel and the Mathematics of Consciousness
abstract: As Penrose notes “the Greek insight that it is mathematics that underscores the workings of physical reality has served us extraordinary well”. This conjecture is a reflection on what mathematics is telling us about the nature of reality and concludes that there are aspects of mathematics that provide insight into consciousness: namely Cantor’s slash and Gödel's theorem.
